premise: Snail is slow getting home at dusk; Firefly glows beside him all the way, and Mouse walks along.
inspiration: The light in the dark from Andersen's tales, turned wholly warm: a small light that brings friends home instead of fading.
lesson: Being slow is fine when friends go at your pace.

en-US.title: Firefly Lights the Way
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 60s} [softly] The sun had gone down, and Snail {snail:pulse} was on his way home. Slowly, slowly. Mouse {mouse:hop} walked beside him, very patiently. It's getting dusky, said Mouse. We could do with a light. Snail was tired. {snail:live} He tucked into his shell for a little rest… waited… then slowly peeked out and looked around. [gasps] Right in front of him was a tiny glowing light. It was Firefly! {firefly:glow} [curious] How do you do that? asked Mouse. You haven't got a lamp! Firefly {firefly:wobble} giggled. I make my own light, she said, {firefly:sparkle} right here in my tail. {canvas:fireflies 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} And she called her friends, blink, blink, blink, until the whole path twinkled. [happily] So Snail and Mouse walked home in the glow, slowly, slowly, and nobody minded one bit. Owl {owl:hearts} watched them go.

es-ES.title: Luciérnaga ilumina el camino
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.6 60s} [softly] El sol ya se había puesto, y Caracol {snail:pulse} volvía a casa. Despacito, despacito. Ratón {mouse:hop} caminaba a su lado, con mucha paciencia. Se está haciendo de noche, dijo Ratón. Nos vendría bien una luz. Caracol estaba cansado. {snail:live} Se metió en su concha a descansar un poquito… esperó… y luego asomó despacio y miró a su alrededor. [gasps] Justo delante de él brillaba una lucecita. ¡Era Luciérnaga! {firefly:glow} [curious] ¿Cómo lo haces?, preguntó Ratón. ¡Si no tienes farolillo! Luciérnaga {firefly:wobble} se rio. Hago mi propia luz, dijo, {firefly:sparkle} aquí mismo, en la colita. {canvas:fireflies 0.7 30s} {sfx:crickets} Y llamó a sus amigas, parpadeo, parpadeo, parpadeo, hasta que todo el camino centelleó. [happily] Así que Caracol y Ratón volvieron a casa entre lucecitas, despacito, despacito, y a nadie le importó ni un poquito. Búho {owl:hearts} los vio pasar.

crickets.prompt: a soft summer evening meadow with gentle crickets
